zh: 国产AI芯片现在到底追到英伟达哪一步了？
en: How far have Chinese AI chips caught up with NVIDIA?

zh: 今天是这次AI创业能力提升训练营的最后一天。
en: Today is the final day of this AI entrepreneurship training camp.

zh: 这条视频就是把我之前留下的作业给大家交一下。
en: This video is my answer to the question I left earlier.

zh: 训练营里有两个企业参访。
en: The camp included two company visits.

zh: 第一站我们去了兰州市信创产业园，
en: Our first stop was Lanzhou Xinchuang Industrial Park,

zh: 也是咱们甘肃省的信创适配基地。
en: also the Gansu Xinchuang Adaptation Base.

zh: 在这我看到了海光DCU对标英伟达A100，
en: There I saw Hygon DCU compared with NVIDIA A100,

zh: 性能大约能做到八成左右。
en: with performance described at around eighty percent.

zh: 这件事最有价值的地方在于国产算力
en: The real value is that domestic computing power

zh: 已经能拿到真实的产品和应用场景里去讨论了。
en: can now be discussed through real products and use cases.

zh: 这场竞争也早就在单一的芯片比拼
en: The competition has moved beyond a single chip

zh: 延伸到了整机制造、软件生态、行业交付的全链条。
en: to servers, software ecosystems and industry delivery.

zh: 而这块国产AI芯片背后的服务器产线，
en: The server production line behind these domestic AI chips,

zh: 生态适配中心就在我们兰州本地。
en: and the ecosystem adaptation center, are here in Lanzhou.

zh: 那现在兰州国产芯片有了，服务器产线有了，
en: Lanzhou now has domestic chips and server production lines,

zh: 数据园区也有了。
en: as well as a data park.

zh: 那么就连我们现在AI落地的这些课程也开了。
en: Even practical AI implementation courses are now available.

zh: 为什么很多本地企业真的想用AI
en: So why do many local firms still struggle

zh: 还是不知道怎么把它串成一个能用的项目。
en: to connect these pieces into a usable project?

zh: 这五天训练跑下来，我带走最有价值的东西
en: After five days, the most valuable thing I took away

zh: 不是认识了几个新的工具，也不是说是记住了多少园区和企业。
en: was not another tool or a list of parks and companies.

zh: 其实我总结下来就是四个字，责任链条，
en: I summarized it in four words: a chain of responsibility.

zh: 产业能力不会自动变成企业的结果。
en: Industrial capability does not automatically become business results.

zh: 中间必须有人站出来，承担业务翻译，数据边界，流程验证，
en: Someone must translate the business, define data boundaries and test the process,

zh: 验收交付，还有长期维护的责任。
en: then own acceptance, delivery and long-term maintenance.

zh: 先看硬件端，一台服务器从零部件到最终交付，
en: Start with hardware: a server goes from parts to final delivery

zh: 要经过装配、前测、老化、复检，
en: through assembly, pre-test,

zh: 系统安装，包装入库，整整一套流程。
en: aging, re-test, system setup and packing.

zh: 那么芯片装进机箱只是第一步，
en: Putting the chip in the chassis is only the first step.

zh: 驱动能不能跑，系统和软件能不能适配，出了问题谁来兜底。
en: Can drivers run? Can software adapt? Who takes over when it fails?

zh: 这些环节缺一个，企业最后就不敢用。
en: Miss one link and the company will not dare to use it.

zh: 再看数据端，第二站我们去了永新国信数据要素产业园。
en: On the data side, our second stop was Yongxin Guoxin Data Element Industrial Park.
highlights: 永新国信数据要素产业园

zh: 这里要聊的核心问题是，数据怎么经过采集、整理，授权，
en: The key question was how data is collected, organized and authorized,

zh: 评估，安全管理，然后变成企业真能用，
en: evaluated and secured, then made genuinely usable,

zh: 出了问题还能追溯的生产资料。
en: traceable production material when something goes wrong.

zh: 很多企业老板觉得我公司里有合同，
en: Many owners think having contracts,

zh: 有客户表，有产品资料，
en: customer lists, product files and proc

zh: 有操作流程，就能直接喂给AI了。
en: edures means AI can use them directly.

zh: 其实根本不是这样的，哪个版本的文件是有效的，
en: It does not. Which file version is valid?

zh: 谁有权去查看哪些内容能进模型，客户的敏感信息要不要脱敏，
en: Who may view it? What enters the model? Must sensitive data be masked?

zh: AI给出错误结果时谁能发现怎么退回原来的流程。
en: Who catches AI errors, and how does the process roll back?

zh: 这些问题不解决的话，服务器性能再强模型再新，
en: Without answers, even stronger servers and newer models

zh: 也只能停在演示阶段落不了地。
en: remain demonstrations instead of working systems.

zh: 所以说国产AI产业的能力要走进本地企业，
en: For domestic AI capability to enter local companies,

zh: 中间缺的到底是什么，是一个完整的责任链，
en: what is missing is a complete chain of responsibility,

zh: 是每一个环节明确的协作位置。
en: with a clear collaboration position at every link.

zh: 这几天的课其实全在围绕同一件事追问，
en: Every course these days was asking the same question.

zh: 知识库课问的是AI拿什么资料干活，
en: The knowledge-base course asked what information AI works with.

zh: 知识产权课提醒你，拿到资料不等于你有权使用。
en: The IP course warned that access does not equal permission.

zh: 企业AI落地课讨论的是系统怎么接进真实业务流程，
en: The enterprise AI course asked how systems enter real workflows

zh: 出了错怎么去处理。
en: and how errors are handled.

zh: 到了数字营销和AIGC最终还要回答你做出来的内容和服务，
en: Digital marketing and AIGC still have to answer one thing:

zh: 到底有没有真实的人需要。
en: does anyone genuinely need the content or service?

zh: 这些课看起来各讲各的，
en: These courses may look separate,

zh: 放进一家企业里本质就是四个问题，
en: but inside a company they become four questions:

zh: 拿什么做有没有权做，
en: what do we use, and do we have the right to use it?

zh: 做进哪段业务最后谁来验收。
en: Which workflow does it enter, and who accepts the result?

zh: 落到实处，本地企业和准备做AI落地的从业者分别该干什么。
en: So what should companies and AI implementers do?

zh: 企业这边要把自己的真实问题摊开，
en: Companies must lay out the real problem,

zh: 明确哪些资料可以用，什么样的结果才算合格。
en: define usable information and what counts as a qualified result.

zh: 做AI应用，做落地服务的人，
en: People building AI applications and implementation services

zh: 要把业务需求翻译成可执行的流程，
en: must translate business needs into executable workflows,

zh: 用小范围的数据先做出能检验的结果，
en: test checkable results with a small data scope,

zh: 再把系统人员合作方全部串联起来。
en: then connect systems, people and partners.

zh: 一旦涉及国产化迁移，软硬件适配，
en: When domestic migration and hardware-software adaptation are involved,

zh: 法律合规还有背后的后期运维，
en: along with legal compliance and later maintenance,

zh: 就必须交给有测试能力，有官方授权，
en: the work needs teams with testing capability and verified authorization,

zh: 能够承担售后责任的专业团队来做。
en: that can take responsibility for support.

zh: 我始终认为，协作不代表责任可以悬空，
en: Collaboration never means responsibility can remain empty.

zh: 每一次环节的一个交接，都得有一个具体的人把责任接住。
en: At every handoff, a specific person must take it over.

zh: 这里给大家一个马上就能用的方法，
en: Here is a method you can use immediately:

zh: 你现在给你正在谈的项目，写一条责任链。
en: write a responsibility chain for the project you are discussing.

zh: 业务结果，谁来提出，数据权限，谁来批准，
en: Who defines the business result? Who approves data access?

zh: AI流程，谁来搭建，系统出错，谁来接管。
en: Who builds the AI workflow? Who takes over when the system fails?

zh: 最后的结果，谁来验收，谁来长期维护。
en: Who accepts the result and owns long-term maintenance?

zh: 这里面只要有一格，你还写着到时候再说，
en: If one box still says “we will decide later,”

zh: 那这个项目就还没有真正的准备好。
en: the project is not actually ready.

zh: 所以回到第一集留下的那份作业，
en: Back to the assignment left in episode one:

zh: 现在我可以给出一个答案，
en: I can now give an answer.

zh: 我真正学到的是AI进入企业之后，
en: What I learned is that when AI enters a company,

zh: 场景，数据，流程和责任必须完整的连在一起。
en: scenario, data, process and responsibility must stay connected.

zh: 我也看到了兰州已经有了国产芯片生态，
en: I also saw Lanzhou build a domestic chip ecosystem,

zh: 服务器的制造测试，数据服务，还有落地能力的培训。
en: server manufacturing and testing, data services and implementation training.

zh: 那么这些实实在在的产业入口，我会继续陪着本地的企业，
en: These are real industrial entry points. I will keep helping local firms

zh: 把这些业务问题，资料边界，流程标准，
en: clarify business problems, information boundaries and process standards,

zh: 验收条件一点点地捋清楚。
en: then define acceptance conditions step by step.

zh: 先做出一个能落地能检查的小结果，
en: We start with one result that can be implemented and checked.

zh: 如果有专业适配和长期运维的部分，
en: For professional adaptation and long-term maintenance,

zh: 正好在这里问一下有没有专业的团队能和我一起完成的，
en: I am also looking for qualified teams that can work with me.

zh: 评论区留言聊聊。
en: Leave a comment and let us talk.

zh: 最后，屏幕前的你，如果现在正在考虑一项企业AI业务，
en: If you are considering an enterprise AI project now,

zh: 先别着急告诉我你准备用哪个工具，
en: do not start by telling me which tool you want to use.

zh: 把这五个责任人写出来，
en: Write down these five responsible people.

zh: 看看你最缺的是哪一个，
en: See which one is missing.

zh: 把空着的那一格打在评论区，
en: Put the empty role in the comments.

zh: 后面我会用真实的项目继续给大家去拆解。
en: I will keep breaking this down through real projects.

zh: 我是超哥，在兰州AI创业
en: I am Chao, building an AI business in Lanzhou.
